stories.title: Spain begins three days of mourning after train crash kills at least 68
stories.summary: Spain began national mourning after a high-speed train struck a stationary one near Toledo; the transport minister blamed an “inexplicable” control-centre order to restart a train despite a stop signal.

stories.title: Netanyahu bloc leads Israel count with 53 seats as Arab parties surge
stories.summary: With absentee ballots still being counted, Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc holds 53 of 120 Knesset seats to Gadi Eisenkot's 48 — neither a majority — after record Arab-sector turnout.

stories.title: Milwaukee Brewers win first World Series title in franchise history
stories.summary: The Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to claim their first championship in 57 years, capping a 103-win season and an 11-2 postseason run.

stories.title: US expels Cuban diplomat after confrontation at UN headquarters
stories.summary: Washington expelled a Cuban diplomat after Cuba's foreign minister loudly interrupted a speech by UN ambassador Mike Waltz criticizing Havana, deepening a US-Cuba rift over sanctions.

stories.title: Researcher builds Microsoft Edge full-chain exploit using only logic bugs
stories.summary: Security researcher Orange Tsai published a complete browser exploitation chain against Microsoft Edge built entirely from logic bugs, with no memory-corruption flaws.

stories.title: Analysis: Claude Code sends each background agent's transcript to its model
stories.summary: A widely shared technical analysis reports that Anthropic's Claude Code transmits each background agent's full transcript back to its model, raising questions about agent context and privacy.

stories.title: Qwenputer: a working, deterministic RISC-V CPU emulated inside Qwen3.5
stories.summary: A project demonstrates a functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU running inside Alibaba's Qwen3.5 model, turning the LLM into a general-purpose computing substrate.

stories.title: GitLab security incident: attempted exploitation of CVE-2026-97229
stories.summary: Alpine Linux reported a security incident in which attackers attempted to exploit CVE-2026-97229 against its GitLab instance, part of a wave of CI and supply-chain attacks.

stories.title: Ryan Day declines to name starting QB, urges rallying around new starter
stories.summary: With Julian Sayin sidelined indefinitely, Ryan Day declined to name Luke Fahey or Tavien St. Clair as the starter before USC, saying the team must rally around whoever gets the nod.

stories.title: Day expects 'full arsenal' on offensive line against USC
stories.summary: Ryan Day expects a fully healthy offensive line and most injured defenders back for Saturday's game at USC as the Buckeyes prepare for a top-16 showdown.

stories.title: Antonelli: Austin win was better executed than his Monza comeback
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli says his United States GP win from pole was better executed than his sensational Monza victory from 19th, as he closes in on the title needing just two points in Mexico.

stories.title: Mercedes pokes fun at Antonelli's awkward Austin reversing mishap
stories.summary: Mercedes shared in-car footage of Kimi Antonelli backing into a fence in Austin with the caption “Championship leader BTW,” a light moment amid his title charge.

stories.title: Verstappen flags two recurring Red Bull problems: 'We should use sign language'
stories.summary: Max Verstappen said too many small things went wrong at the US GP — poor starts and recurring radio failures — joking Red Bull should switch to sign language.

stories.title: Alonso blasts driving standards of the bottom half of the F1 grid
stories.summary: Fernando Alonso hit out at the standard of driving in the lower third of the grid after first-lap contact with Alex Albon left his Aston Martin with floor damage in Austin.

stories.title: EFT: Arena adds 'Bloodlust,' a melee-only 5v5 slasher mode for Halloween
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov: Arena launched Bloodlust, a 5v5 mode with firearms disabled and players in horror-movie-style masks fighting only with melee weapons, plus double XP during the event.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov Patch 1.3.0.0 adds Halloween event; Unity 6 move slips to November
stories.summary: Battlestate Games shipped Patch 1.3.0.0 with a Halloween event, fall weather, skill reworks and high-difficulty PvE bots, while pushing the Unity 6 engine transition to mid-November (1.3.5.0).

stories.title: Trump touts Ramaswamy, Husted at Chillicothe midterm rally
stories.summary: President Trump campaigned in Chillicothe ahead of the midterms, boosting Ohio candidates Vivek Ramaswamy and Jon Husted as the November election nears.

stories.title: How Columbus ballot Issues 8 and 9 would reshape City Council
stories.summary: Issue 8 would limit council elections to district voters, while Issue 9 would do the same and expand council from nine to 13 members — both on the Nov. 3 ballot.
